tools.description: Read one public web page and return its content: the main text (as Markdown with response_format="markdown"), links, metadata and a quality score, plus the raw HTML if you ask (return_html). Set render=true for pages that build their content with JavaScript, or mode="auto" to render only when a plain fetch comes back empty. extract pulls named fields out with CSS selectors. Costs 1 credit for a plain fetch and 5 credits when the page is rendered; with return_html a plain fetch costs 1 credit for each started 400 KB of HTML returned, at most 5. A failed call costs nothing. Pages that disallow automated access or need a login cannot be read.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the language headers of the request, for example ae or gb. It does not route the request through that country.

extract.description: Named fields to pull out with a CSS selector, for example {"heading":{"selector":"h1"},"links":{"selector":"a","attribute":"href", "multiple":true}}. One tag, class, ID or attribute selector each. Static pages only.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key (16 to 128 letters, digits, _ . : -) to retry this exact call safely: a retry within 24 hours returns the first result and is not charged again.

max_cost.description: With mode=auto, the most to spend: 1 never renders, 5 may render.

min_quality_score.description: Refuse the page, at no charge, when its quality score is below this.

mode.description: "manual" (the default) does what render says. "auto" fetches the page plainly and renders it only when it looks empty; it holds up to max_cost credits and charges what it used.

render.description: Run the page's JavaScript in a browser first, for pages that build their content in the browser. Costs more.

response_format.description: Use "markdown" to get the page's main content as Markdown in data.markdown, the best form for reading or summarising. "all" (the default) and "text" return the standard fields: text, links, metadata and a quality score.

return_html.description: Also return the page's raw HTML in data.html (up to 2 MB). Costs 1 credit for each started 400 KB of HTML returned, at most 5. Not with extract.

url.description: The full public http(s) address of the page.

wait_for.description: A CSS selector to wait for before reading. Needs render=true.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after the page loads. Needs render=true.
